### [`unused_ff80`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_ff80.asm#L6) `$FF80-$FFF9`

*data*

Nothing reads $ff80-$fff9. $ff80-$ffcf hold the $00/$ff fill pattern of RAM after power-on.
